chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُولَوَيْهَ وَالْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ بَنْدَارٍ الْقُمِّيُّ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ – أَنَّ بَعْضَ أَصْحَابِنَا سَأَلَهُ وَ أَنَا حَاضِرٌ …

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad b. Qulawayh and al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Bundar al-Qummi from Sa'd b. Abdallah from Muhammad b. Isa b. Ubayd from Yunus b. Abd al-Rahman – that one of our companions asked him while I was present …

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ لِي: إِنَّ أَبَا الْخَطَّابِ كَذَبَ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ أَبَا الْخَطَّابِ وَ كَذَلِكَ أَصْحَابُ أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ يَدْسُونَ هَذِهِ الْأَحَادِيثَ إِلَى يَوْمِنَا هَذَا فِي كُتُبِ أَصْحَابِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ …

translations.en: He said to me: Verily Aba al-Khattab lied about Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) – may Allah curse Aba al-Khattab, and likewise the companions of Aba al-Khattab do insert these narrations into the books of the companions of Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) to this day …

en.summary: This narration from Rijal al-Kashshi highlights the critical Shia scholarly practice of *jarh wa ta'dil* (discrediting and validating), specifically targeting Abu al-Khattab and his followers for their tendency to fabricate or distort hadiths attributed to Imam al-Sadiq (AS). It underscores the historical concern that these fabricated reports were systematically inserted into the canonical collections of the Imam's companions, necessitating rigorous verification by scholars like Yunus b. Abd al-Rahman to preserve the authenticity of the Sunnah.
en.seo_question: Who lied about Imam al-Sadiq and how did their companions affect the hadith literature?

key_terms.أبو الخطاب: Aba al-Khattab, a prominent companion of the Imams known for narrating hadith
key_terms.أبو عبد الله: Abu Abdillah, title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.أصحابنا: Our companions (referring to the Shia scholars/companions of the Imams)
